name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: Must have resided in Malta throughout the 12 months immediately preceding the date of application.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 12 continuous months of Malta residence immediately before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Must show an aggregate minimum of 4 years of residence during the 6 years preceding the application, in addition to the immediately-preceding 12 months.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue an aggregate 4 years of residence within the preceding 6-year window.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires two sponsors: at least one from a designated profession (Member of Parliament, judge, magistrate, advocate, notary, doctor, senior public officer, police inspector or above, Armed Forces captain or above, or parish priest) and a second adult Maltese citizen.
Adequate knowledge of the Maltese or English language is required.
requirements.fix_path: Demonstrate adequate Maltese or English language ability.

requirements.blocker_text: Good character required; overall suitability as a citizen is assessed at ministerial discretion.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 12-month continuous plus 4-year aggregate residence
Form E application (EUR450 + EUR50 on collection)

sources.title: Agenzija Komunita Malta -- Acquisition of Citizenship: naturalisation requirements (12-month + 4-of-6-year residence, sponsors, language, character), Form E, Oath of Allegiance

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Notably unusual sponsor system for a modern naturalisation process: a first sponsor must come from a specific, colonial-administrative-style list of designated professions -- this is confirmed at tier-1, not an assumption. The 'suitable citizen' clause gives the Minister broad discretion beyond the listed objective criteria; selection_method kept as 'assessed' rather than 'automatic' for this reason even though most named criteria are checklist-style. Oath of Allegiance required before the grant is completed. prerequisites.minimum_months_held (48) and continuity_required (false) reflect the aggregate 4-of-6-year rule; the SEPARATE immediately-preceding 12-continuous-month rule is modelled as its own hard requirement (mtn_recent_12mo) since the schema's top-level prerequisites block cannot represent both a continuous tail and a non-continuous aggregate at once.
